name: ChartKit benchmarks

core.note: Phase 2 head the timings were taken on. This docs branch does not contain that commit.

reproduce: Median of 5, Playwright Chromium, a 640×360 line, three x spacings. This file does not re-time the libraries.

methodology.browser: Playwright Chromium, a 640×360 line, median of 5. Shapes are even x, jittered x, and gapped timestamps. ChartKit initial is mount(); the aligned update is mount().update().
methodology.updates: The aligned update starts at the top of a requestAnimationFrame. The harness awaits the library's own completion, then reads the clock from a MessageChannel task after that frame's style, layout, and paint. GPU and raster time is not in the number. ChartKit is measured through mount(element, spec).update(spec), the same shape as uPlot's setData. The figure is the median of five samples.
methodology.sampling: mark.sampling defaults to auto and minmax-downsamples a line longer than twice the plot width. 1,000 points stay complete. The samplingNone rows draw every point and use the same aligned update timer.
methodology.bundle: gzip -9. ChartKit’s headline line is scripts/size.mjs. Competitor rows and the harness chartkit-minimal line are the bench harness. uPlot’s JS and stylesheet are gzipped separately and the uPlot row sums those two responses. The JS figure is the loss named in the headline.
methodology.ssr: Mean and median of 8 calls after 2 warmups, a 1,000 point line. supported false means no chart without a DOM. Recharts returned an empty wrapper.
methodology.agents: Round 6 is the scoreboard. claude-sonnet-4-5, temperature 0, 42 tasks, one run on 2026-10-16. Not re-run for round 13. Official means the library docs were in the prompt. ChartKit docs are llms.txt. repair() is a no-model step on ChartKit's no-docs first try and is not a second model call. Nivo and uPlot were not in the agent eval.

headline.otherFigures: round 13, measured 2026-10-18 on phase 2 d8dcc5a, except the agent eval and the bundle rows

paint.caption: Two-rAF completion, animation and tooltips off, sampling auto. Median of 5 at 640×360. Run date 2026-10-29. Phase 3 rival cells in the same file stay from 2026-10-28. A cell is initial ms / update ms. DNF means the run errored or timed out. N/A means that library has no native chart of that type. An em dash means this run did not include that cell. Spike is ChartKit only; every rival is N/A. The line row is sampling auto at 100,000 points. The sampling-none rows are the dense line, ChartKit only. This is not a hover-steady time.
notes: Candlestick in the table is 100,000 candles, the size the other libraries were timed at. ChartKit also finished 2,000 candles at 23.8 ms initial and 18.9 ms update.

Other line sizes (1,000, 10,000, and the 1,000,000-point sampling-auto cell) and the canvas line stay in paint.json. They are not extra rows here. Bundle size and server render are not in this matrix.

headline.bundleLoss: That is a loss to uPlot at 23,276 bytes. The stylesheet is 762 bytes more, a separate response, and the two sum to 24,038, still smaller than ChartKit.
headline.lineWins: It is still smaller than Chart.js (49,374), Recharts (96,213, React external), Nivo (96,583, React external), Observable Plot (97,723), and ECharts (162,991).
headline.donutWin: The harness donut is 15,085 bytes and is smaller than Chart.js (46,922), Nivo (75,518, React external), Recharts (90,090, React external), and ECharts (122,174). uPlot and Observable Plot have no donut.
